senses.en_definition: To hold one's ground or remain in position without retreating.
To defend oneself against an attack or threat.
To persevere or refuse to give in under pressure or in difficult circumstances.
To last or remain sufficient for a period of time.

messages.en: Where are you? It's boiling here. I can't take this much longer.
I'm behind you, by that tree. Come over here first, then we can take turns waiting in line.
Okay, I'm coming. Even sitting under the tree for a bit will do.
I've got a lot more work on my plate this week.
Want a hand? I've finished my part.

collocations.en: have a responsibility to one's family

messages.en: Have you checked our dinner reservation?
Yep, I'm handling the reservation. Just turn up when it's time.

senses.en_definition: To ask for information or an explanation.

messages.en: I'm at the office already, but I'm not sure which counter to hand this form in at.
There's no harm in asking. Try asking the person at the front counter. They can help.
Right, I've asked. Turns out I need to take a number first. Good thing you told me to ask!
